concerns.text: T002 executes `python -m src.main --config .../config/small_demo.yaml` and validates against `empirical_results.schema.yaml`, but no task produces `src/main.py`, `src/config/defaults.yaml`, or `config/small_demo.yaml`. T001 only creates directories and a quickstart doc. Consumer-before-producer: the end-to-end run has no implementing producer task.

T009 modifies `src/environment/runner.py` and T012 runs 'the runner script', but no task creates `runner.py` or the training/orchestration loop it contains. The resource guard and the full sweep both depend on an unproduced artifact.
T017's verification runs `bash run_full_pipeline.sh`, but no task creates `run_full_pipeline.sh`. The reproducibility task consumes a script with no producer.

T013 computes 'one-sample t-test for heuristic bias (heuristic_variance_mean – theoretical_noise_variance)' and false-positive/stability rates, but no task produces the full-batch variance estimates (FR-013) or per-step ratio data that SC-003/SC-004 stability and false-positive computations require; T010 stores only per-run heuristic estimates. Missing producer for T013's inputs.

T087 and T089 are restatements of T008 and T015 with no distinct deliverables, placed AFTER the reporting phase (T016–T017). If kept, they must precede T012/T016 (their artifacts feed the sweep and final report); as written they create a late-phase duplicate that rewrites artifacts the final report already consumed.

T001 is tagged [P] but T002 (sequential, [S]) immediately depends on its output; the [P] tag is only safe relative to other tasks, which is fine, but the footer claims scaffold tasks are 'already verified ([X] in the original list)' while all checkboxes show `[ ]` — inconsistent completion state confuses dependency evaluation.
